fields.description: Tried first for triage, drafts and summaries. Edited in the helpdesk app: Settings → AI providers.
fields.label: Primary AI Provider

fields.description: When the primary runs out of balance or quota, refuses the key, can't find the model, errors (5xx) or times out.
fields.label: Fall Back to the Other Provider
Anthropic-compatible API
fields.description: Anthropic: api.anthropic.com. Anthropic Compatible: Kimi/Moonshot, GLM/Zhipu — same API shape, set Base URL. OpenAI Compatible (older setting): Poolside, Qwen — use the OpenAI provider for these now.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: e.g. https://api.moonshot.ai/anthropic or https://inference.poolside.ai/v1

fields.label: Investigation Provider
fields.description: Optional override: run investigation sessions on a different provider than triage (e.g. cheap OpenAI-compatible triage + Anthropic investigation). Blank = same as Provider above. OpenAI-Compatible is not offered here — sessions need Anthropic tool-use.

fields.label: Investigation API Key
fields.description: Blank = reuse the main AI API Key.

fields.label: AI API Key
fields.description: Key for the Anthropic-compatible provider. Stored only on the Hub — customer sites never hold an AI credential.
Leave as is for OpenAI; any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint also works.
fields.label: OpenAI Base URL

fields.description: Must match the model ID in your OpenAI dashboard exactly.
fields.label: OpenAI Model

fields.description: Optional: a job's own model in each section. Without a row, a job uses the section's model; the order and the fallback stay as above. A change applies to the next call.
fields.label: Models per job

fields.description: In seconds (300 = 5 minutes)
fields.label: Max Session Time

fields.description: Pause the session after this many tool calls for agent review. Set to 0 to disable pausing.
fields.label: Initial Tool Calls (Deep Dive Pause)

fields.description: Caps applied to tool-call arguments before the Hub forwards them to customer sites. These protect the Hub's Anthropic token budget regardless of customer-side limits. Claude Desktop / Web sessions bypass these caps.
fields.label: Tool Call Limits (Token Budget)

fields.description: Max rows returned by get_list. Effective limit = min(Sonnet request, this, customer ceiling).
fields.label: Hub Max List Limit

fields.description: Max entries returned by get_error_log.
fields.label: Hub Max Error Log Limit

fields.description: Max rows returned by execute_report.
fields.label: Hub Max Report Rows
Auto Investigate
fields.description: After triage, automatically investigate tickets that need more than a how-to answer, on the customer's connected site (reads error logs and data). Proposed fixes still need approval.

fields.label: Draft KB Articles from Resolved Tickets
fields.description: When a ticket is resolved, the AI drafts a knowledge base article if other customers are likely to ask the same thing. Drafts are never published automatically.

fields.label: Hub's Own Work Shown As
fields.description: AI triage and investigation notes, reminders, KB drafts and changes from Outlook or GitHub are credited to this user, e.g. a "TBO AI" user (ai@teambackoffice.com). Empty: Administrator. Agents' own replies stay theirs.

fields.label: Internal customer
fields.description: The customer the watcher's alert tickets belong to (TBO itself).

fields.label: Internal project
fields.description: The project the watcher's follow-up tasks go to (certificates expiring, disks filling up).

fields.label: Watcher quiet after (minutes)
fields.description: Minutes without a heartbeat before the Agent Managers hear that the watcher is quiet.

fields.label: Pause auto-repair
fields.description: While on, the watcher repairs nothing, approved repairs included. Teams: "pause auto-repair" / "resume auto-repair".

fields.label: Runbooks turned off
fields.description: One runbook name per line, for example disk-cleanup. The others still run.

fields.label: Automatic repairs per hour
fields.description: Across every runbook; more waits for the next hour.
